plain.text: The temple leaders were annoyed that the apostles were teaching about resurrection through Jesus. They arrested Peter and John. But many who heard believed, about five thousand men. The next day the rulers asked, "By what power or what name did you do this?" Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said the man was healed by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom they crucified but God raised. "Jesus is the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone. Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved."

The leaders were astonished at the courage of Peter and John, ordinary, unschooled men, and realised they had been with Jesus. They could not deny the healing. So they ordered them not to speak or teach in Jesus' name. Peter and John replied, "Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God's sight to obey you rather than God. We cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard." After more threats, they let them go.

Peter and John went back to the other believers and reported everything. Together they prayed to God, the Sovereign Lord who made heaven and earth. They asked him to consider the threats and enable his servants to speak his word with great boldness, and to heal and do signs through the name of Jesus. After they prayed, the place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.

All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed their possessions as their own; they shared everything. With great power the apostles testified to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. There were no needy people among them, because those who owned land or houses sold them and gave the money to the apostles to distribute to anyone in need. Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus whom the apostles called Barnabas ("son of encouragement"), sold a field and brought the money.

summary.bigIdea: Ordinary believers, filled with the Spirit, speak boldly about Jesus and share generously with each other.
points: Peter declares there is salvation in no other name than Jesus.
"We cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard."
The believers pray for boldness and share everything so no one is in need.
summary.reflection: The leaders noticed that Peter and John "had been with Jesus". What would people notice about you?
